column1: # *** ONE OF THE FOUR UNTRACED FATHERS OF CAJON 985 IS FROM MONTEVIDEO. 9 October 2026. ***
# *** THIS FILE SAID 'ORIENTAL' FOR AN HOUR. THE SECOND ACT SAYS THE CITY. ***
# /open-questions/ question 1 - the question this archive exists to answer - now asks strangers for
# the origins of four men named as FATHERS on the Lerena cards of the army drawer. This file traces
# the first of them, and it was reached by a PARENT-PAIR QUERY on the wife's surname.
# *** THE METHOD, AND IT IS CHEAP: *** search the record index for surname LERENA with SPOUSE SURNAME
# CARNIGLIA. A distinctive married-in surname cuts a crowd to three records in one query.
# *** AND THIS VOLUME CARRIES A WAYPOINT, WHICH ALMOST NONE OF THIS ARCHIVE'S WORK DOES. ***
# Q633-3DR, checked against the Record Atlas's own volume data before it was written down:
# "mendoza, 1899-1903, Bautismos 1899-1903". The act is 6 January 1900, inside the range.
what was read
*** THE ACT ***
column2: *** Santiago Apostol y San Nicolas (la Iglesia Matriz de Mendoza), Baptism Records 1899-1901 ***; DGS film 004597291, image 69, ark 3:1:939X-HF9M-7S, *** waypoint Q633-3DR ***. Baptism of *** 6 January 1900 *** by the cura Dr. J. Juan Jordan. *** PLATE READ 9 October 2026 - there is no AI transcript for this image. ***
column3: *** MARIA ADELA, hija legitima de D. CARLOS LERENA y ADELA CARNIGLIA *** - a daughter this archive did not hold. *** THE CLERK GIVES NO MONTH FOR THE BIRTH: *** 'nacio el quince del ano pasado', so the fifteenth of some month in 1899, and the formula is left incomplete rather than finished for him.

column1: *** AND THE WORD THAT MATTERS ***
column2: The parents are '*** orien[tales], domiciliados en este Curato ***' - the word runs over the line end and is read across both halves at full magnification
column3: *** CARLOS LERENA IS ORIENTAL - URUGUAYAN. *** data/cajon-985-origins.tsv had him as 'Not established'. *** THAT MAKES FOUR OF THE DRAWER'S TRACEABLE FATHERS, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM URUGUAYAN OR MARRIED IN URUGUAY *** - Gilberto, Alejandro Maximo, Nemesio Ramon and now Carlos. *** IT STRENGTHENS A BASE RATE RATHER THAN MAKING A LINK: *** in this generation an Argentine Lerena is a Uruguayan family's son far more often than not, and *** JUAN CARLOS LERENA, WHO LEFT NO TRACE AT ROSARIO AT ALL, FITS THAT SHAPE. ***

column1: *** AND A LERENA STOOD GODFATHER ***
column2: 'fueron padrinos *** Domingo Simois POR ABELINO LERENA *** y Lucia L. de Simois' - the act names a proxy and the man he stood for, and both signed: *** Dgo. Simois *** and *** Lucia Lemos de Simois ***
column3: *** AN AVELINO LERENA IS GODFATHER TO CARLOS'S DAUGHTER, BY PROXY, AT MENDOZA IN 1900. *** data/cajon-985-origins.tsv noted that Carlos named a son *** AVELINO CARLOS *** in 1904 and called it 'suggestive only'. *** IT IS NO LONGER ONLY A FORENAME: there is a real Avelino Lerena in his circle. *** *** AND IT IS STILL NOT AN IDENTIFICATION. *** This register holds *** FOUR *** men of that name - Avelino Lerena Fernandez (b.1815, head of the Lerena Traibel branch), Avelino Eduardo Lerena Traibel, Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre and Avelino Lerena Villademoros - and the act gives no patronymic, no age and no residence for him.

column1: *** WHY THE CAUTION IS NOT BOILERPLATE HERE ***
column2: The adjacent row of data/cajon-985-origins.tsv, for *** ARTURO LERENA ***, was written as 'Montevideo 1858, son of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel' and *** WITHDRAWN THE SAME DAY *** as a conflation with *** JUAN ARTURO LERENA TRAIBEL ***, whose wife was Ema Regules
column3: *** THIS ARCHIVE HAS ALREADY ATTACHED A CAJON 985 FATHER TO AVELINO LERENA ONCE AND BEEN WRONG. *** *** SO CARLOS IS RECORDED AS ORIENTAL, WITH AN AVELINO IN HIS CIRCLE, AND NOT PLACED IN ANY BRANCH. *** *** WHAT WOULD PLACE HIM: *** his own marriage to Adela Carniglia, which would name his parents; or the second daughter's act.

column1: *** AND A SECOND DAUGHTER, NOT YET OPENED ***
column2: The same parent-pair query returns a third child: *** MARIA MERCEDES LERENA ***, Argentina, Mendoza, Catholic Church Records 1665-1975, ark 3:1:1:QVN9-3S53 (index)
column3: *** THREE CHILDREN NOW WHERE THE DRAWER SHOWED ONE: *** Avelino Carlos (1904), Maria Adela (b.1899, bap. 1900) and Maria Mercedes. *** HER ACT IS UNREAD *** and is the cheapest next step on this man, because a second baptism may give what this one does not - his own parents, or a place he was natural of.

column1: *** AND A SPELLING THIS REGISTER HAS CARRIED WRONG ***
column2: The act writes the mother *** ADELA CARNIGLIA ***, with an r; the FamilySearch index of the army card agrees
column3: *** THIS REGISTER HAS HELD HER AS 'ADELA CAMIGLIA' SINCE 13 SEPTEMBER ***, without the r, and so has her husband's row. *** THE ACT IS THE BETTER WITNESS AND THE INDEX AGREES WITH IT ***, so CARNIGLIA is recorded as the reading and CAMIGLIA kept beside it as what this archive used to say. *** CARNIGLIA IS AN ITALIAN SURNAME *** - she may be Uruguayan-born of Italian parents, which is what 'orientales' in the plural would cover.

column1: *** AND THE SECOND DAUGHTER'S ACT NAMES THE CITY ***
column2: *** Santiago Apostol y San Nicolas, Baptism Records 1901-1903 ***, DGS film 004597291 item 003, image 95, ark 3:1:939X-HFTB-Z. *** A PRINTED FORM - 'Partidas de Bautismos de la Parroquia Matriz DE MENDOZA' - WITH A 'natural de' BLANK FOR EACH PARENT. *** 'A *** 23 dias del mes de Abril de este ano 1902 ***... bautizo... a *** MARIA MERCEDES LERENA *** que nacio en esta ciudad el *** 10 del mes de Marzo del ano de 1902 ***. Hija legitima de D. *** CARLOS LERENA, natural de MONTEVIDEO ***, y de Dona *** ADELA CARNIGLIA, natural de MONTEVIDEO ***.' *** PLATE READ 9 October 2026. ***
column3: *** CARLOS LERENA IS NATURAL DE MONTEVIDEO - THE CITY, NOT JUST THE COUNTRY. *** The 1900 act gave only 'orientales'; *** THE 1902 ACT IS A PRINTED FORM AND THE FORM ASKS THE QUESTION ***, which is the whole difference between the two readings. *** AND ADELA CARNIGLIA IS MONTEVIDEAN TOO ***, so an Italian surname in Mendoza by way of the Banda Oriental. *** THE CHEAPEST NEXT STEP NAMED BY THIS FILE AN HOUR AGO WAS THIS ACT, AND IT PAID. ***

column1: *** AND A SECOND LERENA GODPARENT, AGAIN BY PROXY ***
column2: 'Padrinos D. *** EDUARDO CARNIGLIA *** y Dona *** MERCEDES LERENA DE MARTINEZ ***, representada por *** Adela S. de Carniglia ***'
column3: *** TWO LERENAS HAVE NOW STOOD GODPARENT TO CARLOS'S CHILDREN AND NEITHER CAME. *** Avelino Lerena in 1900, by proxy through Domingo Simois; *** MERCEDES LERENA DE MARTINEZ *** in 1902, by proxy through the child's own mother. *** A GODPARENT WHO MUST BE REPRESENTED IS A GODPARENT WHO LIVES SOMEWHERE ELSE *** - and Carlos is from Montevideo, which is where somewhere else most likely is. *** THE CHILD IS NAMED MARIA MERCEDES FOR HER. ***

column1: *** AND SHE IS NOT IDENTIFIED, THOUGH THE REGISTER IS FULL OF CANDIDATES ***
column2: This register already holds *** MERCEDES LERENA (godmother, 1880, Montevideo) ***, *** MERCEDES MICAELA LERENA TRAIBEL (b. 8 May 1863, Montevideo) ***, *** MERCEDES LERENA (m. Luis P. Marquez 1883, Montevideo) *** - and, separately, *** CAROLINA LERENA (de MARTINEZ) ***, wife of *** JULIAN MARTINEZ ***
column3: *** A LERENA WOMAN MARRIED TO A MARTINEZ IS ALREADY IN THIS REGISTER, AND HER NAME IS CAROLINA, NOT MERCEDES. *** So either a second Lerena sister married a Martinez, or one of the Mercedes Lerenas did, or Carolina went by another name. *** NONE OF THE THREE IS CHOSEN. *** The act gives her no age, no father and no town, and this archive has spent today correcting two identifications made on exactly this much. *** WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT: *** a Montevideo marriage of a Mercedes Lerena to a Martinez.

column1: *** WHAT THE TWO ACTS DO TOGETHER ***
column2: 1900: 'orientales', with an Avelino Lerena godfather. 1902: 'natural de Montevideo' twice, with a Mercedes Lerena de Martinez godmother.
column3: *** ONE OF THE FOUR UNTRACED FATHERS OF CAJON 985 IS NOW PLACED IN A CITY, WITH TWO NAMED LERENA RELATIVES. *** *** AND THE BASE RATE SHARPENS WITH HIM: *** Gilberto Lerena Lenguas was born at Montevideo in 1855, Alejandro M. Lerena in Uruguay in 1844, Nemesio Ramon married at Salto in 1903, and Carlos is natural de Montevideo. *** FOUR TRACEABLE FATHERS IN THAT DRAWER AND NOT ONE OF THEM ARGENTINE. *** *** THAT NAMES NOBODY ***, and it is the frame against which a Juan Carlos Lerena who left no trace at Rosario should be read.
